'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Mark Sebring LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Sebring]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed)|OVS17-10-We_ll_Handle_This-remaster.webp|label=We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Jedi! Jedi! Jedi!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
